decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster belongs to the core coolant-management business and costs little to keep, and two years of evidence are still too few to show its value will not be realized, so the option stays open.

The cleaning centrifuge complements the firm's filtration systems at low holding cost, and although recent withdrawals in the coolant line add some risk, nothing yet shows its value is unlikely to be realized.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the conveyor range with steady metalworking demand, so they are a well-proven option worth keeping rather than abandoning.

Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core product type for machine tool users and support the modular offering at little cost, which justifies keeping them, especially after the magnetic conveyor variant was dropped.
